description: Aero Hand dances to the music: listen to what's playing and move the hand along with it so it flows with the song. The agent decides the approach (e.g. beat and tempo tracking plus energy/onsets driving finger waves, pinches and poses; smooth trajectories, nothing jerky). Extend third_party/aero_hand/scripts/performance.py (it already starts a random song from the ¿? playlist). LEFT hand; mind servo temperature over a full song.

user_request.name: listening to the music and then moving the hand along with the music. I'll let you interpret what that means, but it should flow nicely with the music.

summary: The Aero Hand should dance to the music playing, using beat, tempo and energy tracking to drive smooth finger waves, pinches and poses. Extend performance.py, which already starts a random playlist song, on the LEFT hand while keeping servo temperature safe across a full song.
